```text
# PR #5097: Patch: follow-up to #5073 from the after-merge spot-check

Closes #5091

## What changed

The finding holds. #5073 took the only `background` off seven `::before`/`::after` boxes, so they drew nothing, and two of them still ran an animation. A scan of `main`'s stylesheets lists all seven as boxes that draw nothing. All seven are fixed as the plan says:

**Given a flat fill again, using the gradient's old middle stop**, so each draws and plays at most once as R5014000 says:
- `skeleton/skeleton.css`: the skeleton's sheen `::after` takes `var(--skeleton-sheen)`, which is read again.
- `practice/practice.css`:
  - the AI-thinking light along the HUD's edge (`.practice-hud::after`) takes `var(--opponent)`. The HUD's `overflow: hidden` hides it while it rests past the left end.
  - the thinking orb's ring (`.practice-thinking__orb::before`) takes `--opponent` at 70%. Its `practice-spin` animation is gone, since a ring of one color has nothing to turn, and so is its entry in the Reduce Motion list. `@keyframes practice-spin` stays because the result screen's rays use it.
- `game/deckbuilder/deckbuilder.css`: the title's gold hairline `.db-header::after` takes `--pal-gold-400` (the old `rgb(240 194 74)`) at 55%.

**Deleted with their rule**, as R5014000's "a fade drawn on a `::before` or `::after` went" already says:
- `routes/landing.css`: `.landing .landing-fan::before`, the pool of hearth light under the fan.
- `notfound/notfound.css`: `.not-found-way[data-face="up"]::after` with `@keyframes nf-spark`, and `.nf-hand::before`.

The comments now describe what each box actually does.

**A check, so this can't recur (CLAUDE.md rule 15).** `surfaces.test.ts` gains `emptyPseudos` and two `R5091000` tests:
- It lists every `::before`/`::after` that a sheet creates (`content` other than `none` or `normal`) and that no rule anywhere paints. "Paints" means text of its own, a background, a border, an outline, a box-shadow or a backdrop.
- It groups rules by the selector's last compound, so a fill set in a state rule (`[data-thinking="true"]`) or inside an `@media` block counts.
- Eight boxes paint nothing on purpose: six touch targets and two spacers that keep a card name clear of its cost gem. They are named in `EMPTY_PSEUDO`, each with its reason. I checked each reason against its rule.
- On `main` the scan finds 15: those eight plus the seven from this issue. On this branch it finds exactly the eight.

**Spec:**
- New ruling `spec/rulings/R5091000.md`, with its §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/5091.md`.
- One "Amended by" paragraph at the end of `R5014000.md`.
- One sentence added to `apps/web/README.md`'s #5014 paragraph.

`motion.test.ts` lowers `practice/practice.css`'s raw-time count from 42 to 41, because the ring's `0.9s` went. No other per-sheet count moved.

## How I tested it

- **Web test files:** 10 files, 97 tests pass: `surfaces`, `motion`, `palette`, `compositor-loops`, `spacing`, `buttons`, `static-pages`, `typescale`, `breakpoints` and `skeleton/Skeleton.test.tsx`. Both `R5091000` tests are among them, by name.
- **The harness's own web command** (`vitest run --project web --changed origin/main` with its excludes): 242 files, 4782 tests pass. The 14 skipped tests are the tree's existing skips, not added here.
- **Before and after:** a node copy of the same scan gives 15 boxes on `main` (`git archive HEAD`) and the 8 named ones on this branch.
- **Other checks, all passing:**
  - `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`
  - `pnpm exec eslint` on the two test files
  - `cargo jackioh spec check`: "2683 rulings … ok"
  - `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims`: "Internal", so no card change and no patch fragment
  - `cargo jackioh patches check` and `cargo jackioh catalog check`
  - `cargo fmt --check`
  - `cargo test -p jackioh-tools --test acceptance`: 61 passed
- **Not run here:** no Rust changed, so I left clippy and the workspace's cargo tests to the harness.

## Decisions the issue did not settle

All of these are recorded in R5091000's Rejected list.
- **Pools and spark deleted, not filled.** A flat fill on those soft radial glows would draw hard-edged ovals. Rejected: a flat fill like the other four.
- **The orb ring stands still.** Rejected: keeping a spin that shows nothing, or redrawing the ring as a border arc so it has something to turn, which would move more per-sheet counters.
- **No gradients brought back.** Rejected: restoring the gradients, which would raise `UNTOKENED_SURFACES`, a count that may only fall; and a gradient `mask` or blurred glow, which would bring the fades back through another property.
- **The check covers still boxes too.** Rejected: checking only animated ones, which would have missed the hairline and the two pools.

## Worth a second look

- **What players see changes:**
  - the deck builder's hairline is now flat across its full width instead of fading at its ends;
  - the skeleton's sheen is a flat full-block band sliding across once;
  - the orb ring no longer turns.

  All of this is presentation only, with no effect on the engine, the view or the log (rule 7).
- **The scan can miss, but never fails falsely.** It groups rules by last compound across all sheets, so a hit area such as `index.css`'s `:where(…)::before` is grouped under the bare `::before`, which another rule paints, and so it doesn't need an `EMPTY_PSEUDO` entry.
```
